goal: Add a Tarjetas/Lista view toggle to the country grids in Calibración and Pesaje, persisted per-module in localStorage, showing the same data and actions in both views.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Calibración page shows a visible Tarjetas/Lista toggle control; clicking it switches the grid to a table/list layout without a page reload, and back.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: CalibrationPage.test renders toggle, clicks 'Lista', asserts table/row markup appears and card markup disappears (and vice versa). Playwright: e2e/calibration.spec.ts click toggle, assert row count matches prior card count.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The list view for Calibración shows the same information (país, Sync/Cal badges, estado Cerrado/Abierto, elegibilidad/pesaje '?' badges) and the same actions (Calibrar button, Stop button while running, eye/detail icon, whole-row click opens the same history modal with the same aria-label used today) as the card view — no functionality lost.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: CountryListRow.test asserts same badges/buttons render from same props as CountryCard.test. Playwright: e2e/calibration.spec.ts (list mode) exercises Calibrar confirm dialog and clicks a row to open history modal, asserting the same aria-label ('View calibration history for {country}') and modal title as history-unify.spec.ts.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Pesaje page shows the same Tarjetas/Lista toggle; the list view shows the same information (país, last-finalized badge, estado) and actions (whole-row click opens detail modal, history icon button opens history modal, Stop button while running) as WeightingCountryCard.
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: WeightingCountryListRow.test. Playwright/vitest: PesajePage toggle test asserts row click opens detail modal and history icon opens history modal.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The Tarjetas/Lista preference persists across a reload, independently per module (Calibración and Pesaje can be in different modes at once).
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: vitest: useViewMode.test sets localStorage key per module, re-mounts hook, asserts it reads back the persisted value; asserts two different module keys don't collide.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No regressions: full vitest suite, eslint, and tsc -b remain green; existing e2e/calibration.spec.ts and e2e/history-unify.spec.ts still pass unmodified (or with only additive changes, no weakened assertions).
acceptance_criteria.how_to_verify: npm test && npm run lint && npx tsc -b; MOCK_SERVER_PORT=8000 npm run test:e2e:fast

tasks.desc: Add generic localStorage-backed useViewMode(moduleKey) hook (src/hooks/useViewMode.ts) returning ['cards'|'list', setViewMode], with try/catch guarded localStorage access (mirrors CalibrationPage.tsx existing pattern) and a vitest test covering default, persistence, and per-module isolation.

Extract CountryCard's business logic (calibration mutation, showHistory/showDetail state, canTrigger gating) into a shared hook src/modules/calibracion/components/useCountryCardState.ts, refactor CountryCard.tsx to consume it with zero behavior change (existing CountryCard.skipSync.test.tsx must still pass unmodified).

Add CountryListRow.tsx (table row) using the shared hook from t2, rendering the same badges/actions as CountryCard in a <Table> row layout; whole-row onClick opens history modal with the same aria-label. Add vitest test asserting parity with CountryCard for the same fixture props.

Add a small ViewToggle.tsx component (two buttons/icons, Tarjetas|Lista) in src/components/, wire useViewMode('calibracion') + ViewToggle + conditional CountryListRow/Table rendering into CalibrationPage.tsx. Add vitest test toggling the view and asserting markup swap.

Extract WeightingCountryCard's business logic into useWeightingCountryCardState.ts (same pattern as t2, zero behavior change), add WeightingCountryListRow.tsx, and wire useViewMode('pesaje') + ViewToggle into PesajePage.tsx. Add vitest tests mirroring t3/t4 for Pesaje.

Extend e2e/calibration.spec.ts with a list-view case (toggle to Lista, assert same Calibrar/history interactions as the card case) without weakening existing assertions. Run full VERIFY_CMD including Playwright smoke.
